thesis: Europe's clearest fast-reserve market, and already oversupplied: connected storage exceeds the fast-reserve need, so the revenue line is withheld rather than assumed. No capacity contract exists; secured revenue is a floor negotiated project by project. Two hours.
欧洲最清晰的快速备用市场，但已经供过于求：已并网储能超过快速备用需求，因此收入线暂不列示而非假设。没有容量合同；锁定收入只能逐个项目谈保底。两小时。

reason: A fixed connection fee of EUR 1,000,000 at 110 kV is paid for the connection agreement to take effect, about 5% of the reference project. Nothing is posted as security.
接入110kV须缴纳100万欧元固定并网费，缴费后并网协议方才生效，约占参考项目投资的5%。无需提交任何担保。
capitalAtRisk.author: analyst

reason: The operator publishes the process, the prerequisites and where capacity is open and closed.
运营商公布流程、前置条件，以及容量开放与关闭的区域。
approvalTransparency.author: analyst

reason: New storage connections are restricted in the south until 2029 and available in the north.
南部在2029年前限制新增储能并网，北部仍可接入。
gridScarcity.author: analyst

reason: Greenfield projects sit outside the screening act in force, but buying a ready-to-build project is an acquisition, so the grade is set a step below. A new act covering storage from 100 MW is planned for 2027 and is tracked as a trigger.
新建项目不在现行审查法适用范围内，但收购具备开工条件的项目属于并购，因此评级下调一级。计划于2027年生效的新法将涵盖100MW及以上储能，已作为触发事件跟踪。
foreignEntry.author: analyst

reason: A grid-priority bill and operator tariff decisions are pending; no retroactive change is recorded.
并网优先顺序法案与运营商电价决定尚待出台；未见追溯性变更。
policyStability.author: analyst

reason: Data centres with signed connection agreements exceed 3 GW.
已签署并网协议的数据中心超过3GW。
demandGrowth.author: analyst

reason: About 4 GW of storage agreements are signed and about 1 GW connected, against fast-reserve obligations of roughly 0.8 GW.
已签署约4GW储能并网协议、已并网约1GW，而快速备用义务量约为0.8GW。
saturation.author: analyst

text: The south is closed to new storage until 2029 and capacity remains in the north.
南部在2029年前不再接纳新增储能，北部仍有容量。
More than 3 GW of data-centre load has signed connection agreements.
已有超过3GW的数据中心负荷签署并网协议。

despite: About 5 GW of storage is signed or connected against reserve obligations under 1 GW, so reserve revenue will not carry a platform.
已签约或已并网的储能约5GW，而备用义务量不足1GW，备用收入撑不起一个平台。
strategic.author: analyst

text: No capacity contract or tender exists; secured revenue has to be negotiated as a floor, project by project.
没有容量合同或招标；锁定收入只能逐个项目谈保底。
Far more storage is signed than the reserve markets need.
已签约的储能远超备用市场所需。

despite: Small projects and a fast, published process make this one of the easiest markets to put capital into.
项目规模小、流程公开且快，是最容易投入资本的市场之一。
infraFund.author: analyst

text: Greenfield storage sits outside the screening act in force today; a ready-to-build purchase is an acquisition, and its ownership route has to be confirmed first.
新建储能目前不在现行投资审查法的适用范围内；但收购具备开工条件的项目属于并购，须先确认其股权路径。
The operator publishes the process, the prerequisites and where capacity is open.
运营商公布流程、前置条件以及容量开放的区域。

despite: The easy entry leads into a crowded market: far more storage is signed than the reserve markets need.
进入容易，但进去的是一个拥挤的市场：已签约的储能远超备用市场所需。
foreignFirstTimer.author: analyst

text: Connection capacity outside the south is the scarce asset, and it is still obtainable.
南部以外的并网容量才是稀缺资源，而且目前仍拿得到。
A short path to ready-to-build by the standards of the other three markets.
与另外三个市场相比，达到开工条件的路径较短。
No security is posted. The cost is a fixed connection fee of about USD 1.1m, inside what it will risk on one project.
无需提交担保。成本是一笔约110万美元的固定并网费，在其单个项目愿担的风险范围之内。

despite: Buyers of a ready-to-build project face a crowded reserve market, which caps what they will pay for it.
具备开工条件的项目，其买方面对的是拥挤的备用市场，这限制了他们愿意支付的价格。
developer.author: analyst

label: New investment-screening act planned to take effect, covering greenfield storage from 100 MW
新的投资审查法计划生效，涵盖100MW及以上的新建储能项目
Government bill on grid-connection priority rules, due autumn 2026
政府关于并网优先顺序规则的法案，预计2026年秋季提出
Reserves and trading · 2h · ready-to-build, with a negotiated floor
备用服务与交易 · 2小时 · 具备开工条件，谈定保底
why: Reserve markets pay for fast power, not hours, and connected storage already exceeds the fast-reserve need; a negotiated floor is the only secured revenue.
备用市场为快速功率而非时长付费，而已并网储能已超过快速备用需求；谈定的保底是唯一的锁定收入。

text: Price ready-to-build projects only with a negotiated floor in place; read the grid-priority bill due this autumn.
只为已谈定保底的具备开工条件项目定价；关注今年秋季提出的并网优先法案。

fi-mer-2h.author: analyst
